gauge_killed_flag.meaning: the gauge is in the killed/inactive state with supplyIndex frozen at its pre-kill value

index_gap_grows.meaning: while the gauge is inactive the gap between supplyIndex[gauge] and the global index grows with each notifyRewardAmount

revived_without_reset.meaning: the killed gauge is revived without resetting supplyIndex to the current index

retroactive_claim_occurred.meaning: the revived gauge retroactively claims rewards that accrued during its inactive period

assumptions: killGauge() and reviveGauge() are invoked without synchronizing supplyIndex[_gauge] with the global index.
_updateForAfterDistribution() computes rewards using the delta between current index and stale supplyIndex[_gauge].
The stale supplyIndex makes the delta span epochs when the gauge was dead.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify the retroactively claimed reward amount; only a qualitative worst-case is given, so the claim is represented as a Boolean occurrence rather than a numeric relation.
Report does not state who triggers kill/revive or whether the caller is unauthorized.

limitations: The claim is formalized only for the retroactive_claim impact; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
Reward amounts are not quantified, so the relation is a Boolean occurrence of the retroactive claim rather than a numeric inequality.
The condition encodes the concrete killed-then-revived scenario described by the report, not a fully general ineligibility scope.
